description: This file defines the StructureShape class, which models a structure shape with member references within the AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to manage and access shape members, including checking for existence, retrieval, and generating member hashes.

classes.name: StructureShape
classes.description: Represents a structure shape and resolve member shape references within the AWS SDK for PHP. It manages a collection of shape members and provides methods to access and verify them.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a StructureShape instance, setting its type to 'structure' and defining its members.

methods.name: getMembers
methods.description: Returns all member shapes, generating the hash if not already generated.

methods.name: hasMember
methods.description: Checks if a member with a specified name exists.

methods.name: getMember
methods.description: Retrieves a member shape by name, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: generateMembersHash
methods.description: Generates the internal hash of members based on the definition.
